question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH distinct_words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words 
  FROM word_list 
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL AND words != ''
),
word_chars AS (
  SELECT words, 
         LENGTH(words) AS word_len,
         STRING_AGG(ch, '' ORDER BY ch) AS sorted_chars
  FROM (
    SELECT words, 
           SUBSTR(words, n, 1) AS ch
    FROM distinct_words t,
    LATERAL (SELECT * FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(words)))) AS gs(n)
  ) sub
  GROUP BY words
),
all_anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT words, 
         word_len, 
         sorted_chars,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sorted_chars) AS total_anagram_count
  FROM word_chars
),
filtered_words AS (
  SELECT words, word_len, sorted_chars, total_anagram_count
  FROM all_anagram_counts
  WHERE word_len BETWEEN 4 AND 5 
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
)
SELECT words, total_anagram_count - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM filtered_words
WHERE total_anagram_count >= 2
ORDER BY words
LIMIT 10
